name: databricks-bridge
description: Connects the chat to Databricks-hosted MCP endpoints: Databricks SQL, a Genie space and Unity Catalog functions. One connector, several endpoints; credentials are stored as secrets and never written to config files. Results respect the permissions of the identity you configure.

tools.name: (from Databricks)
tools.description: The tools are whatever the configured Databricks endpoints expose, for example SQL execution, Genie questions and your Unity Catalog functions.

client_id.title: Service principal client ID
client_id.description: OAuth machine-to-machine client ID. Leave empty if you use an access token instead.

client_secret.title: Service principal client secret
client_secret.description: Stored as a secret, never written to config files.

access_token.title: Access token (alternative)
access_token.description: Optional. A bearer token you already have. Whether a personal access token is accepted depends on the endpoint; OAuth is the documented path.

oauth_scope.title: OAuth scope
oauth_scope.description: Scope requested for the machine-to-machine token. Default all-apis; narrow it to the scopes of the endpoints you use (for example sql, unity-catalog) once everything works.

mcp_paths.title: MCP endpoint paths
mcp_paths.description: Comma or line separated, each /path or alias=/path. Add your Genie space as genie=<path of its MCP endpoint> once you have it. See examples/databricks-demo/README.md.
